summary: Seritage Growth Properties subsidiary entered an option purchase and sale agreement with Arena Development Intermediate for a Dallas property. Purchase price is $50,760,000 with adjustments; closing is the earlier of 90 days after entitlements period expiration or January 31, 2028. Option payments start at $169,200 on effective date, then monthly amounts from July 2026 to January 2028, all non-refundable and incremental to price. The PSA is cross-conditioned with a related PSA for adjacent land by unaffiliated owners. There are no assurances the option will be exercised, making this a contingent asset sale with no definitive terms.
